gloss: to curl up; to roll into a ball; to become rounded

definitions.gloss: to curl up; to roll into a ball; to coil up
definitions.explanation: To become round or curl into a ball shape. Used for people, animals, or objects that take on a rounded, contracted form — like a cat curling up, a person hunching into a fetal position, or a leaf rolling up.

examples.japanese: ネコ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{丸|まる}まって⟦{寝|ね}ている→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: The cat is curled up sleeping.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}くて→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{丸|まる}まって⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: It was cold so I was curled up inside the blanket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{端|はし}→端：00936_hashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{丸|まる}まり⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The fallen leaves dried out and began to curl up from the edges.

notes:
A godan verb derived from ⟦{丸|まる}い→丸い：02967_marui⟧ (round). Describes the process of something taking on a round, compact shape — by curling, rolling, or contracting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {丸|まる}まって⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧: to sleep curled up
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丸|まる}める→丸める：11313_marumeru⟧: to curl one's body up (transitive)
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{丸|まる}まる: to curl up inside the blanket
- ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{丸|まる}まる: a cat curls into a ball

NOTE: The transitive counterpart is ⟦{丸|まる}める→丸める：11313_marumeru⟧ (to round something; to roll something into a ball): ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丸|まる}める→丸める：11313_marumeru⟧ (to crumple paper).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{縮|ちぢ}こまる→縮こまる：08217_chijikomaru⟧: to huddle, to scrunch up — implies shrinking from cold or fear
- ⟦うずくまる→うずくまる：18290_uzukumaru⟧: to crouch, to squat — lower-body crouch rather than full body curl
